about: Sunday roasts, stews, biscuits and cookies.

recipes.title: Whole Roast Chicken
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Pat the chicken dry. Rub it all over with the butter, salt and pepper.
Put the lemon, garlic and thyme inside the bird.
Roast breast-side up for 75 minutes, until the juices run clear and the thickest part of the thigh reads 165°F.
Rest for 15 minutes before carving.

recipes.title: Pot Roast
steps: Heat the oven to 300°F. Season the beef with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a heavy lidded pot. Brown the beef well, 4 minutes per side. Lift it out.
Cook the onion and garlic in the same pot for 3 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste.
Put the beef back. Add the stock and rosemary. Cover and cook in the oven for 2 hours.
Add the carrots and celery, cover again and cook 1 hour more, until the beef falls apart.

recipes.title: Beef Stew
steps: Toss the beef with the flour, salt and pepper.
Brown the beef in the oil in batches in a heavy pot. Set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic for 3 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste.
Return the beef. Add the stock and bay leaf. Cover and simmer gently for 90 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes. Simmer 45 minutes more, until everything is tender.

recipes.title: Meatloaf
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Mix the beef, onion, eggs, breadcrumbs, milk, salt, pepper and Worcestershire with your hands until just combined.
Shape into a loaf in a baking pan.
Stir the ketchup and brown sugar together and spread over the top.
Bake for 60 minutes, until the middle reads 160°F.
Rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Melt the butter and soften the onion, carrots and celery for 5 minutes.
Add the stock, chicken and thyme. Simmer for 20 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through (165°F).
Lift out the chicken and shred it with two forks.
Add the noodles and cook for 8 minutes.
Return the chicken. Season and stir in the parsley.

recipes.title: Mashed Potatoes
steps: Cover the potatoes with cold salted water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer for 15 minutes, until a knife slides in easily.
Drain well. Return to the pot over low heat for 1 minute to steam dry.
Mash with the butter, then beat in the milk until smooth. Season.

recipes.title: Roast Potatoes
ingredients: 2 lb potatoes, peeled, in large chunks
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F with the oil in a roasting tin.
Boil the potatoes in salted water for 10 minutes.
Drain, then shake them in the pan to rough up the edges.
Carefully tip them into the hot oil, turn to coat, and sprinkle with salt.
Roast for 45 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.

recipes.title: Roast Vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Cut all the vegetables into chunks of about the same size.
Toss with the oil, salt, pepper and thyme. Spread in one layer on a tray.
Roast for 35 minutes, turning halfway, until tender and browned at the edges.

recipes.title: Pan Gravy
steps: Pour off all but about 2 tbsp of fat from the roasting pan.
Set the pan over medium heat. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in the stock, scraping up the brown bits.
Simmer for 5 minutes, until thick. Season to taste.

recipes.title: Buttermilk Biscuits
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F.
Mix the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Rub in the butter until it's the size of peas.
Stir in the buttermilk just until it comes together.
Pat to 1 inch thick, fold in half twice, pat out again and cut into rounds.
Bake on a sheet for 12 minutes, until tall and golden.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Beat the butter and both sugars until fluffy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda and salt.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto ungreased sheets, 2 inches apart.
Bake 9 to 11 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Cool on the sheet for 2 minutes, then on a rack.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F.
Beat the butter and both sugars. Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking soda, cinnamon and salt.
Stir in the oats and raisins.
Drop tablespoons onto sheets, 2 inches apart.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes, until golden at the edges.

recipes.title: Apple Crumble
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F.
Toss the apples with the sugar and cinnamon in a baking dish.
Rub the flour, brown sugar and butter together with your fingers into crumbs. Stir in the oats.
Scatter the crumble over the apples.
Bake for 40 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
